coupling: The lossless sliding-window commit changes VP8LGetWindowRows from a double-sized window to its documented minimum. That minimum still includes the caller-supplied history and is safe for its lossless caller. The later alpha-window commit supplies only one history row, relying on the former double-sized window to cover the 24-row final macroblock batch. With both edits, alpha receives only 21 rows at width 4096, so the lossless alpha extraction writes past its allocation. Either edit alone leaves sufficient capacity; a repair must account for the alpha decode batch and the shared helper sizing together.
